region.name: Kerala
region.scope: Full State of Kerala; excludes Mahe, Puducherry Union Territory
region.source_license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0
region.routing_note: State containment enables a neutral Kerala CMO grievance handoff, with K-SMART as a local-body alternative. It does not identify a local body, PWD road, road owner, complaint category, water authority, or department.
limitations: The OpenStreetMap boundary is a routing aid, not a legal boundary record.
Mahe and neighbouring states are outside this route.
The user must select and verify the district, department, local body, category, and asset owner.
Local-body, PWD, KWA, NHAI and other ownership is not inferred.
Pothole Reporter opens the official service but does not submit a complaint automatically.
